items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Berlin in the context of popular songs, but the interviewee (Vic Dickenson) does not respond or provide any personal connection.

ctx.x: So they don't adapt themselves to...
Yeah. You know, like, popular songs, like the kind that Berlin wrote and those people like that, Porter and all them... They don't use those songs. There is no place to put them in Rock-and-Roll.
